# The Last Collection Is an Operational Event — motion and channel evidence manifest

Version 2.0 · RN Collins · 7 September 2026

## Reels / TikTok / Shorts
### 0–8s — OBJ-84652
Voiceover: Made after Charles Frederick Worth’s death, the dress lets the house name continue in the record without proving who controlled every creative or economic decision.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Gift of Miss Eva Drexel Dahlgren, 1976

Rights: Public Domain / Met Open Access

### 8–16s — CN03-DIAGRAM-1
Voiceover: 01 · STABILIZE — Who and what need an answer today?. Inventory safety, payroll, benefits, contractors, customers, deposits, deadlines, facilities, systems, insurers, lenders, and emergency contacts. Identify the authorized interim decision-maker from actual records.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 16–24s — CN03-DIAGRAM-2
Voiceover: 02 · FREEZE — Which changes should stop?. Preserve files, samples, accounts, logs, agreements, permissions, money movements, and public drafts; suspend deletion and irreversible publication while legal holds, privacy, and access are reviewed.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 24–32s — CN03-DIAGRAM-3
Voiceover: 03 · DECIDE — Can unfinished work continue?. Assess creative authority, contributor consent, labor, contract, quality, finance, rights, customer, cultural, and reputational consequences for ship, pause, complete, transfer, or cancel.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 32–40s — CN03-DIAGRAM-4
Voiceover: 04 · ACCOUNT — How will the institution explain the outcome?. Publish only verified decisions, preserve dissent and credits, notify affected parties before spectacle, record refunds or remedies, and archive the rationale and authority.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 40–48s — S08
Voiceover: Personal Digital Archiving is retained as evidence, education, reporting or rights context.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Library of Congress

Rights: Link and quote narrowly; check each downloadable resource before redistribution.
